svg.title: Remaining phases roadmap for AI Creative Studio POC
svg.desc: Four remaining phases: Phase 4 media persistence, Phase 5 Electron JWT, Phase 6 error UX, Phase 7 job history. Two optional phases: Redis rate limiting and load testing.

g.text: ✅ Completed: Phase 1 (security) · Phase 2 (JWT) · Phase 3 (browser pool) + all bug fixes
Login flow + token refresh in app
Detect session expiry, show renewal reminder in app
Phase 4 → 5 → 6 → 7 → 8 (builds in this order — each is independent)
Phase 4 is highest impact — active URLs expiring breaks completed jobs
